content_sections.text: Qualification: A PhD in Social Anthropology; A Master's degree with 55% marks in Anthropology from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University; Other essential qualifications as per the UGC's 2018 regulations Other conditions: No travel allowance will be provided for the interview.
